name: image-gen-openai-hk
description: Generate and edit images with gpt-image-2 through OpenAI-HK curl-compatible endpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and edit images through OpenAI-HK gpt-image-2.
interface.longDescription: A local Codex plugin for OpenAI-HK image generation. It provides a skill and script for text-to-image and image editing requests against gpt-image-2 curl-compatible endpoints, saves generated images locally, and can print redacted curl examples.
defaultPrompt: Show me the gpt-image-2 curl command.
